# Moyosore Saibu

Official professional homepage: https://moyosoresaibu.com/
Optional social-entry page: https://moyosoresaibu.com/start/

Moyosore Saibu is a Nigerian commercial professional focused on sales execution, trade activation, territory management, route-to-market strategy, customer development, commercial analytics and practical AI-assisted workflows.

## Information architecture

- Contact: https://moyosoresaibu.com/contact
- Start Here (optional social route): https://moyosoresaibu.com/start/

## Site roles
The root homepage is the primary professional authority and search/recruiter entry point. The /start/ page is a distinct optional landing page for visitors arriving from social or shared links. It is not a replacement for the homepage.

## Operating framework
NOTICE → DECIDE → EXECUTE → REVIEW

## Evidence convention
Selected career outcomes are presented with public-source context and stated limits. Evidence notes distinguish public professional claims from internal baselines and confidential operating data.
